title: [code-infra] Bump @types/node to 22 and group it with node in Renovate
body:
Removes the local `@types/node` Renovate rule (own group, `< 21.0.0`) that overrode the shared preset, so `@types/node` now updates together with Node in the `node` group (capped at 22) instead of lagging on 20.x (e.g. #48896).

Also bumps `@types/node` from 20.19.43 to 22.20.4 to match `engines.node` `>=22`.
